item.title: Yanagawa Canal Boat Cruise — Guide
item.description: Yanagawa, a former castle town in southern Fukuoka, is laced with a network of canals that once served its moats and waterways, earning it the nickname the ‘Venice of Kyushu’. The classic way to experience it is a leisurely boat cruise: you board a low, flat wooden donko-bune, and a boatman poles you slowly along the tranquil canals, gliding under low stone bridges (you sometimes duck), past willows, old white-walled storehouses, gardens and glimpses of local life, often singing traditional boat songs along the way.
